notes: Community-maintained compilation of world naval order of battle, not an official navy publication. Recovered from a single-column xlsx export of the Navbase fleet list page, in which all table structure had been flattened into column A.
units: Tonnage is displacement in tonnes as published by Navbase. It is NOT SIPRI trend-indicator value and must not be aggregated with arms_transfers.tiv_millions or budgets.amount_usd.
